text:
Nora Diaz: Quick sync - 2h until marketplace go. Need final owners for press embargo, landing toggle, SKU gating, and SI billing fallback. I'll drop the checklist, pls ack.

Nora Diaz: ```
- embargo lift: 14:00 UTC
- blog + press: 14:00 UTC
- partner co-post: 14:08 UTC (logos at 14:10 UTC)
- landing toggle: feature flag `marketplace_v1_cta` flip at 14:02 UTC
- CDN TTL reduce to 60s at 11:00 UTC
- canary ramp: 14:05 (10%) -> 14:10 (50%) -> 14:20 (100%)
- SI billing fallback window: 13:30-15:30 UTC
```

Ethan Brooks: I'll own CDN and canary routing. Will lower TTL at 11:00 UTC and run pre-warm at 12:45 UTC.

Saira Khan: Marketing here. Press pack is in /drive/launch/embargo_v3. Legal asked for UTC timestamps in all copy. We will not publish partner logos until +8 minutes post-embargo per partner ask.

Omar Alvi: SI update: connector to PartnerX billing webhook failed unit tests overnight. We can route billing to fallback queue during launch window. Patch ETA 09:50 UTC. If patch delayed, fallback stays active until confirmed.

Megan Li: Landing changes merged to main. Flag `marketplace_v1_cta` staged. Rollback cmd: `eng-deploy-bot revert-flag marketplace_v1_cta`. I'll monitor conversion metrics after flip.

eng-deploy-bot: Scheduled flag flip marketplace_v1_cta -> ON at 14:02 UTC. Audit token ag-5501.

Ethan Brooks: Note: a couple of hardware SKUs (A100-40GB-dual, P4d-8x) are not mapped for Azure listing. If we don't have mapping by 12:00 UTC we should hide those SKUs to avoid incorrect billing.

Nora Diaz: Omar, please confirm the SI fallback is live by 13:30 UTC. Ethan, confirm you will hide unmapped SKUs at 12:01 UTC if not present. Megan, keep flag staged until eng-deploy-bot flips.

Omar Alvi: Fallback queue deployed to staging and prod. Will validate by 13:15 UTC. Patch still on track for 09:50 UTC.

Megan Li: Confirmed, will not flip until signal from Nora. UX note: CTA A/B variant B has 10% different copy, Marketing prefers variant B for initial roll.

Saira Khan: Variant B approved. Also adding a short partner-approved quote to the blog. Kevin (legal) cleared last night.

Ethan Brooks: Pre-warm results posted: caches warmed, healthchecks pass. Slight cold-start variance on P4d but under SLA. Posting metrics summary to #launch-metrics.

Nora Diaz: Owners list: Press=Saira, CDN/Canary=Ethan, SI=Omar, Landing=Megan, Legal=Kevin (not in thread). Meeting in #launch-runner at 13:00 UTC for go/no-go. If anything unexpected, call for canary-rollback id cb-2026-11.

Megan Li: :thumbsup: I'll be in #launch-runner to flip flags and watch A/B.

Omar Alvi: :thumbsup: SI oncall 13:30-15:30 UTC. I'll post runbook link in the channel.

Saira Khan: :thumbsup: PR team will be ready at 13:55 UTC for embargo lift. Reminder: partners asked that third-party aggregators not receive assets until logos allowed at 14:10 UTC.

eng-deploy-bot: Canary ramp schedule posted: 14:05 10% -> 14:10 50% -> 14:20 100%. Will auto-roll back if 5xx>0.5% or p95>2s.

Nora Diaz: Thanks all. Final ask: everyone confirm in #launch-runner by 13:50 UTC. See you there. :rocket:
